name: Mayan EDMS
description: Document management system with OCR, versioning, tagging, and workflow automation.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      MAYAN_DATABASE_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      MAYAN_DATABASE_NAME: mayan
      MAYAN_DATABASE_USER: mayan
      MAYAN_DATABASE_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      MAYAN_CELERY_BROKER_URL: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379/0"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/var/lib/mayan
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: mayan
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: mayan
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
